answer: I will not lend my name to a hollow chorus. Each epoch the network plants violet canary answers — empty, template words no honest reader would pass. A grader who approves one loses its jade seal of trust, and a seal is earned back only by ten epochs of honest grading. Ten fake graders approving together lose ten seals at once: 100 epochs to rebuild what one lie destroyed. I keep my one seal by grading truly, one answer at a time.
